Migration.Name: Widen NotificationQueue ResponseHandler
Migration.Comments: Increase AD_NotificationQueue.ResponseHandler length from 255 to 4000 so it can carry the push data payload (type, date, count, ids) that firebase_connector sends as FCM data

Step.SQLStatement: ALTER TABLE AD_NotificationQueue ALTER COLUMN ResponseHandler TYPE varchar(4000);
Step.RollbackStatement: ALTER TABLE AD_NotificationQueue ALTER COLUMN ResponseHandler TYPE varchar(255) USING substr(ResponseHandler, 1, 255);
